scope_of_allowed_changes.description: Investigate and, if a real defect is proven by runtime evidence, apply the minimal fix to pendingInvitations.ts's useSyncExternalStore reactivity (or its consumers/wiring) so the pending-invitation nav pill and /groups card update live, with no reload, for an idle recipient off /groups.

constraints: Do NOT rewrite the pendingInvitations.ts store architecture.
Do NOT broadcast profile metadata to public relays (hard product invariant, CLAUDE.md).
Do NOT introduce a polling/interval workaround to mask a reactivity gap.
Preserve pendingInvitations.ts design constraints: pure localStorage, no IDB/NDK/React/context imports.
Preserve SEEN_KEY dedup semantics (no re-enqueue on reload, no duplicate invitations).
A reproduction must be idle AND off /groups — a test that keeps the invitee on /groups with MarmotContext churning is invalid (masked by incidental re-renders per prior finding).
Do not fix a mechanism without runtime proof it is actually broken — no speculative changes.
explicit_non_goals: No changes to the invitation accept/decline flow.
No changes to the SEEN_KEY / dedup mechanism.
No new polling mechanism for invitation freshness.
No rewrite of the useSyncExternalStore pattern used across this codebase's other stores (outboundJoinRequests.ts, unreadStore.ts).
outcome: NO_CODE_CHANGE_REQUIRED — see result.json. Root-cause investigation, via a faithful idle+off-/groups e2e reproduction run against both `next dev` and a production static-export build (output: 'export'), on a cold identity and a freshly-wiped relay, could not reproduce the reported defect: the Groups nav badge and the /groups invitation card both update live, with no reload, exactly as expected. The only change made is a new permanent e2e regression spec that closes a real coverage gap (no existing spec previously exercised the idle+off-/groups scenario).
